node.title: Re: Best practice for a module which can use one of multiple image modules
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Should I try to detect what's on the system? Should I make MyModule::ImageMagick and MyModule::GD and make the user choose?

I would say that it depends. If you are using the modules simply to generically load images, and nothing else, as your [id://11104276|previous post] implies, then it might be easier to auto-detect what modules the user has on their system ([mod://Imager] is another good one, BTW). If you are building on features that the modules provide, then since your code will depend more tightly on the modules' API, then the second option might make more sense.
